essence: The possibility of agency without an instrument is put in question.
Power alone is stated to be the instrument even for the activities of individual selves.
The status of an ungrasped adjunct as the Lord's effect is challenged.
One devoid of knowledge of the cause cannot properly be an agent.
Without the lamp of power, everything would be total blind darkness.
